title: people-ops
text:
people-ops

Maria K.: Heads up — courier dropped off a potted plant for my 2pm guest but didn't leave it at the front desk. Anyone seen it? tag: `PLNT-4521`
Olivia: We have a small pot on the 'visitors' shelf by the lockers, looks like it. Left a note 'for Maria K.' I scanned it: ID `PKG-PLNT-4521`. @Maria K. can you confirm species? 😅
Maria K.: Yep that's mine! It's a snake plant (low maintenance). Thanks @Olivia. Can you hold it until after my meeting? I'll come pick up.
Olivia: Sure — also badging FYI: guests need ID + signed NDA? Wait — check: we don't require NDA for short visits. Standard temp badge, 1 hour. @People Ops can confirm.
People Ops: Correct — standard visitor flow: ID check, temp badge, escorted to meeting room unless visitor is pre-cleared. If you want unescorted access, add them to the guest list on the calendar event or ping @Olivia before they arrive.
Jamal: If anyone needs seating, there's a free hotdesk on 3rd floor near the cafe. Maria, wanna swap for a quieter spot after the meeting?
Maria K.: Might be good, thanks. Also PS: the plant is labeled 'fragile' — maybe don't put it in the bike-locker area 😬
Sara L.: Quick package note — mailroom's tight today. If you have large or perishable deliveries, please send to the loading dock and mark 'Office — Attn: [Name]'. For anything fragile, DM the mailroom channel or ping @Olivia.
FrontDesk-Bot: Visitor badge printed for 'E. Chen' at 14:05. Badge: TEMP-337. Escort required: yes. :white_check_mark:
Olivia: Also FYI we had a pepperoni box delivered by mistake earlier. If you ordered pizza, come claim it before it goes to compost. 🍕
Maria K.: Lol that wasn't ours. Thanks everyone, I'll swing by in 10.
